text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, morning practice is done! I gotta 
get to the test...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What's going on, you ask? I don't even 
know. I'm just not feelin' like myself 
today.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Jordan, we're gonna prep for the makeup 
exams now, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm not going easy on you today. Brace 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
W-What's up, City? You seem kinda 
different than usual...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that, let's do it! Classical 
Japanese first! Alright, put the right 
particle in the parentheses!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...? "Long ago, th're lived an old 
bamboo cutt'r..." ..."Verily"...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Look at the appendix in the study 
guide. Who even talks like that anymore?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, what's going on, really? Why are you 
suddenly getting so strict...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...You're different from before, aren't 
you? You're actually taking training 
seriously.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So having supplementary lessons eat up my 
time... I just thought it'd be such a 
waste.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
City... Is she actually a total 
heartthrob...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm down then! I'm being totally 
serious this time!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...So anyway, here. Check out the page on 
particles I just mentioned."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh wow, there was a page like this? 
Honestly, there's so much written here. 
That's crazy.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...You're gonna learn that from now on.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...For real?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...So yeah, City went all out getting 
everything prepped for me. Now there's no 
way I can lose, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, off to battle I go. You'd better 
brace yourself, exam!

Worrying about the test results, I went to 
get something to eat... And there she 
was—the very person I had in mind.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sorry, did you wait long?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You're here, City. Alright, time to 
announce it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Since you're here, you might as well 
listen too. ...Here goes..."

Waiting for the results with bated breath. 
And then...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...14 points!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wha! You... don't tell me...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's double what it was last time...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Cityyy! Thank you soooo much!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That "pluralism-suh-something" City was 
talking about popped up, and I finished 
the test first!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you'll definitely get more next 
time!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. This is actually a huge step 
forward for her.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Nobody transforms overnight anyway. As 
long as you feel progress, that's what 
counts.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to City, I didn't completely blank 
out this time! I actually kind of 
understood it...!

With Gold City's support, Tosen Jordan 
gave it her all. What should I say to 
her...
choice_data_list: ...Let's make sure to review it too!
...Let's make sure to review it too!
It's great that you solved it so quickly.

text_block_list.text:
With Gold City's support, Tosen Jordan 
gave it her all. What should I say to 
her...
choice_data_list: ...Let's make sure to review it too!
...Let's make sure to review it too!
It's great that you solved it so quickly.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: W-Whaaat? Already~?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's much more effective to do it while 
the problems are still fresh in your mind.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then if you get out of remedial class, 
I'll take you on a shopping date. How's 
that sound?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Saying something like that... that's just 
unfair!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Alright, got it! In that case, I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Since City's lookin' out for me, I'll do 
my best reviewin' my notes too~âª

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
City! I'm gonna try waaaay harder next 
time! So keep your eyes on me, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Yeah, yeah. I'm looking forward to it."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Totally! There's no way I'd lose at 
speed-solving!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Teachers always say, "If you're done, 
review your work," right? But the answers 
ain't gonna change, so you're just bored, 
aren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
After that, all that's left is for the 
right answer to catch up to my speed!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, either way, at least we're making 
progress!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yay!!
